node.title: Official exact-slice worst-prefix residual budget
node.statement: At every official exact-list corridor row, let A=K+t_XR and let Phi_{A,t_XR} map each A-subset to the first t_XR sub-leading coefficients of its monic locator. For every prefix z, remove the quotient, dihedral, boundary, moment-trade, and other explicitly paid x4 first-match classes, and let R_z be the remaining primitive support/list-member fiber. Prove max_z |R_z| <= N^3=2^123. This is the sufficient exact-slice boundary-prefix budget consumed by x4. A census only of t_XR-null blocks does not prove it: in characteristic p, t-nullity fixes only p-free prefix coordinates, and even a full null fiber need not be heaviest. The guarded full-subset F2 terminal and the proved null-fiber near tails remain evidence for a possible strip-aware exchange-compression route, not logical substitutes for the maximum-prefix quantifier.
node.falsifier: An official corridor row, a locator prefix z, and a certified first-match post-strip fiber R_z with more than N^3 distinct residual supports/list members.
